title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.1 - Peningkatan Responsivitas & Pembaruan Otomatis
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.1 - Faster Loading & Automatic Refresh

id: Tampilan daftar file kini terbuka seketika tanpa perlu menunggu loading lama saat memuat folder.
Penyamaan data dari berbagai akun penyimpan cloud berjalan serentak di latar belakang.
Tampilan file ter-refresh secara otomatis begitu ada pembaruan data dari cloud.
Kestabilan penyimpanan lokal ditingkatkan agar tidak terjadi hambatan saat membaca atau menulis file.
Daftar file kini secara otomatis dibersihkan jika akun terputus atau file terhapus di server cloud.
en: File list opens instantly without freezing or long loading screens when browsing folders.
Multi-cloud drive data syncing now runs simultaneously in the background.
File view automatically updates on screen whenever new data arrives from cloud accounts.
Enhanced local database stability for smoother performance.
File list automatically stays consistent when an account is unlinked or files are deleted in the cloud.

title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.0 - Rilis Perdana & Fitur Pembaruan
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.0 - Initial Release & Update Features

id: Dukungan multi-cloud storage (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud, WebDAV, S3, Telegram).
Aturan alokasi pengunggahan cerdas (Round-Robin, Max Free Space, Mirroring).
Fitur Cek Otomatis Pembaruan dari GitHub Releases.
Halaman 'Tentang Aplikasi', Catatan Rilis (Changelog), dan integrasi System Tray Icon.
en: Multi-cloud storage support (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud, WebDAV, S3, Telegram).
Smart upload allocation strategies (Round-Robin, Max Free Space, Mirroring).
'About App' page, Release Notes (Changelog), and System Tray Icon integration.
